issues.detail: Spec only names a 4-digit BCD counter; contract infers up +1 modulo 10000 on posedge.
issues.alternative: Down-count by 1 modulo 10000 on each enabled posedge.

issues.detail: Spec does not state reset value or reset priority; contract forces q=0 and override.
issues.alternative: Reset loads a non-zero BCD value such as 9999 instead of 0.

issues.detail: Spec does not fix ena packing or timing; contract uses combinational q and bit0=tens/bit1=hundreds/bit2=thousands.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.
issues.alternative: ena is registered on posedge from pre-edge q, so ena remains 0 when q becomes 9 until the next edge.

issues.detail: ena example uses reset=0 rows but expects q=997..1000; it assumes unshown initial q=996 and is not reachable from a reset-cleared state in four cycles.
